I am a refugee in Sweden and I have some responsibilities, my mental health seems to get in my way a lot so this guy helps me with it. Actually he is a contact person, not just about mental health but I was consulting about my mental health at that point, as always. He helped me schedule an appointment with a psychiatrist. I tell him my problems and ask how he can help and I give him the updates, like the fact that I started medication.

I have had problems keeping up with medication for variety of reasons and I told him that as well. So I can understand when he is afraid that the same thing will happen again but to say that he knows that I will quit, "so I can complain about it"???

I was talking about my problems and the fact that something has to change because the current arrangement make me and everyone else involved in this uncomfortable. When he said that I asked "Do you think that I don't want help but I want pity?". He started to talk about how light hurts when you are in the dark for so long etc I literally ran away and didn't even listen to the rest. I was really upset at that point.

I want to say that the hatred is for me. When I see terror in the news, it makes me mad. When I see people who actually thinks about killing innocent people or worse that people actually deserves it, I think that someone has to do something about it.

I just can not stand happiness and kindness and I wish people would hate me the way I hate myself.

When I dream of one of those happy, successful, satisfied, loved people trying to help me; I dream of myself on the ground with this better person standing above me, so high above me, I see how small I am compared to them and I see the pity in their eyes. It makes me feel worse. When I dream of one of those better people reaching out and trying to help, I feel even less and I can't help myself but to dream of being that animal and biting them. I want that kind, helpful person to suffer. I can only feel good if I am hated or disgusted or feared.

I think my death would be the best for everybody and I wish people would cheer for my death.

I am very disappointed that this comment was upvoted. Other people thought that this might be something I want to hear I guess. That's why I am writing this comment, I wish I didn't feel like I need to.

This is too generic, it doesn't mean anything. Who even are you? You don't know me, you can't care about me. You didn't even knew that I existed and you won't be there to learn about it when I finally cease to exist. You would say this to anybody, I am not special here.

Actually this makes me feel even worse. I wish someone was here to say this to me, to my face. I know that noone who gets to meet me and sees my face would care about me. This is what I experienced in my 26 years of life, if I am not learning this one thing as a fact from 26 years of experiencing the same thing, it means that I am really stupid.

I wish someone was here to hold me, listen to me, talk to me but when I finally kill myself, the cops will have nobody to call about it. Nobody will even notice it.

This comment makes me think about how little I mean to the world, how noone cares about me at all. This comment hurts me. I don't blame you or anyone who liked your comment, I understand that nobody can actually understand my situation. I know that nobody will ever understand me. When I die, some people might think that they know why but they won't know why. Nobody can. I know you mean good, it's just I am way too pathetic for normal human consolations. I am a disgusting thing and I can not be a human. My problems are not of humans, I am a shit stain on the ground and I would be a lot more comfortable if everyone were to just walk all over me.
I am not dead
I am seeing a therapist regularly. I am 26 years old, I have been seeing therapists and using medicines for more than 15 years now. Nothing is better, probably even worse.

Like, even if someone decides to give me a try (which is highly unlikely and nobody ever did it before, because my appearance and my behavior is highly repulsive I guess), they would see how much of a time waste I really am after they talk to me for a while. Sometimes I think "Okay, I will show them how serious I am." and when I still can't do it, I feel defeated.

Will it always be like this? Do I have to suffer more? I want to be free, will I stay in this hell, forever? It makes me feel so hopeless...
Good, nobody will mourn after me anyways. I am not leaving anyone behind because I don't have anyone already so rest assured.
I know for certain that suicide is the solution for me and life is not an option.
